data.title: Senior Data Engineer
data.description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap, la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte, dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.
🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics. On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique. Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.


👥L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data). Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations.

L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.


💪 Tes missions

Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

  • Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel.
  • Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.
  • Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).
  • Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses.
  • Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

👀 Comment on travaille
  • Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite.
  • Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue.
  • Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance.
  • Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains.
  • L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence.
  • Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte.

    • ⭐ Notre stack
    • GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker
    • Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery
    • Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary
    • IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions
    • Langages : Python, SQL, Docker
    • IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

    🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche

    Indispensable

    • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production.
    • SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût).
    • Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts.
    • Python de qualité, testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique.
    • Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien.
    • Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit.
    • Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble, et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues.
    • Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote.
    • Anglais B2 minimum.

      • Un gros plus

      • Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership.
      • Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries).

        • Un plus

        • Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm.
        • Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills).
        • Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom).
        • Pipelines data en Change Data Capture.
        • Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte.

    🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un rôle au cœur d'une AI-first scale-up fintech FT120, €145M levés, 8 000+ clients, 6 pays.
    • Une Data Platform avec un vrai scope stratégique (reporting, IA, data gouvernance) et des sujets de fond pour les 2 prochaines année.
    • Rémunération : 60K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • Full remote  — venues à Lyon ponctuelles pour les moments d'équipe.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).
    • Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).
    • Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib / EGYM wellpass, et plus.

    ⏳ Process de recrutement
    1. Screening avec notre Senior Talent Acquisition — 45 min sur ton parcours et ta motivation.
    2. 1er entretien technique avec Pauline (Head of Data) — discussion technique, challenge sur la manière d'aborder des problèmes, cadrage de sujets, use case Agicap — 1h.
    3. 2ème entretien technique avec Kévin (Team Lead DE) et Julien — test SQL + test d'architecture oral + discussion technique + cas IA — 2h.
    Feedback rapide à chaque étape. Process transparent, pas de piège.
    AGICAP s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité!

data.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.


Key Responsibilities:

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding:

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.

data.title: Superstar - Brand Designer / Art Director
data.description:
International Brands is a fast-growing Swiss company in the Personal Care / FMCG space. With our brands, we bring products into tens of thousands of retail locations worldwide, from drugstores and leading retail chains to e-commerce.

We build brands that work on shelf.

Not just on slides. Not just on Instagram.

Fast. Visible. Tangible. Scalable.

And we are nowhere near our limit.

We are looking for an Art Director (100%).

Someone with a deep understanding of FMCG design. Someone who knows what stops consumers at shelf, captures attention and drives sales.

Someone who takes ownership. From packaging and brand worlds to the smallest details that ultimately make the difference.

Someone who challenges existing ideas, wants to improve things and does not accept “the way it has always been done.”

This role is demanding, fast-paced and highly hands-on.

We are not looking for an administrator.

We are looking for a builder.

Someone who takes ownership, moves fast and executes with high quality.

Someone who wants to actively shape and grow brands. Not only conceptually, but all the way through to finished products in the market.

Aufgaben

You own everything that moves our brands visually and creatively forward with a clear focus on FMCG performance in the market.

  • Develop and execute creative concepts across all brands with a focus on visibility, recognition and impact
  • Build, sharpen and continuously evolve strong brand worlds with a consistent visual identity
  • Challenge existing approaches and actively improve things instead of simply maintaining them
  • Design packaging with clear FMCG logic: attention-grabbing, brand-right and built to convert at shelf
  • Develop web, social and marketing assets focused on performance, not aesthetics alone
  • Turn ideas into reality quickly, pragmatically and efficiently without getting stuck in endless feedback loops
  • Actively leverage AI and modern tools to improve workflows, speed and creative output
  • Lead projects independently from idea to finished product in market
  • Manage freelancers and external partners with a high quality standard
  • Work closely with the Head of Brands and the broader team
  • Think beyond design with a holistic perspective from products and communication to the physical environment

Turn design into products that sell. Turn creativity into performance.

Qualifikation

  • 2–5+ years of experience in a creative role (Design, Art Direction or similar)
  • Strong portfolio with real FMCG or retail work and proven execution
  • Very strong Figma skills with experience in UI and web
  • Experience across packaging, social media, web and print
  • Deep understanding of FMCG design, retail and consumer behavior
  • You challenge things and constantly look for ways to improve them
  • You do not only think about aesthetics, but about impact, performance and results
  • You are independent, hands-on, fast and solution-oriented
  • You take initiative and actively drive projects forward
  • You take ownership instead of waiting for instructions
  • You use AI as a practical tool in your daily creative workflow
  • German & English

What does not fit this role:

Purely aesthetic thinking without understanding market dynamics, consumers and commercial impact

Creative profiles without genuine interest in FMCG, retail and market-driven design

Very rigid or overly process-driven ways of working

People who wait for instructions instead of taking ownership

People who love concepts but struggle with execution and speed

Benefits

Direct collaboration with the Head of Brands

Real impact on brands, products and their success in market

Fast decisions instead of endless alignment rounds

High ownership and the opportunity to truly build and shape things

If you want to build something meaningful, this is the place.

You will not simply design.

You will build brands.

You will develop products that get noticed.

Products that stop consumers at shelf.

Products that win.

Products that people buy.

If you are someone who wants to create things that are not just beautiful, but successful, we should talk.

data.title: Head of Customer Success
data.description:
At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences.

As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito.

Are you ready to make an impact?

Your Mission:

Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth.

  • Lead by Example: You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed.

  • Team Development & Coaching: You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup.

  • Escalations & Problem Solving: You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy.

  • Process & Project Innovation: You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage.

  • Commercial Impact & Growth: You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

  • Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

Your Story

You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesses - all fueled by a real enthusiasm for the magic of event tech.

  • SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment.

  • Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation.

  • Effective Communicator: You are a skilled communicator and workshop facilitator who connects effortlessly with enterprise executives, end-users and internal teams alike.

  • Tech Savvy and Agile: You are at home analyzing usage data, mapping workflows and collaborating with Product on technical escalations. You adapt quickly to new software, shifting priorities and changing processes.

  • Leadership Drive: You genuinely care about people. Ideally, you have led a small team before and take true fulfillment in coaching others, building confidence and helping your team grow.

  • Passion for Events and Tech: Events are all about emotion and experience. We are looking for someone who brings that exact enthusiasm for events, event tech and / or digital products.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German, with the ability to comfortably follow Swiss-German in client meetings.

What We Offer

Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins.

  • Impact: Take ownership of a role where your work directly shapes evenito's growth and sets new standards for the industry. You will work closely with management, an amazing team, passionate clients and drive projects that make a difference.

  • Flexibility: As one of our core values, we strongly believe in hybrid remote work options and flexible schedules that allow you to align your professional commitments with your personal life.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge.

  • Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots.

  • Unique Events: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties.

  • Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting.

  • Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop.

Are you ready to shape the future of events with us?

Discover more about life at evenito on our career page, send us your CV and tell us what excites you most about joining our team. We are building something special at evenito - and we can’t wait to meet the person behind the application.

Werde Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, das gemeinsam eine moderne, skalierbare Datenbank- und Infrastrukturplattform gestaltet und betreibt. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, gestaltest Architektur‑Entscheide und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den stabilen Betrieb, das Engineering und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Oracle- und PostgreSQL-Datenbankplattform sowohl im Daily Business als auch in Projekten und Releases.

Gemeinsam treiben wir Themen wie deklarative Infrastruktur, versionierte Changes und reproduzierbare Deployments voran – mit Tools wie Ansible, Terraform und CI/CD Pipelines.

  • Austausch und Weiterentwicklung sind uns wichtig: Du hast regelmässig die Möglichkeit, User Groups und Hersteller-Events zu besuchen.
  • Dich erwartet ein starkes Team: 3 weitere DBAs und 8 Linux Engineers arbeiten mit engem technischem Austausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen zusammen.

  • Du arbeitest in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und Engineering von Oracle oder PostgreSQL Datenbanken.

  • Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch.

data.title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
data.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Responsibilities
  • Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options.
  • Find the right suppliers. You run market scans, requests for information and requests for quote. Then you shortlist the suppliers worth a closer look.
  • Judge capability together. You work with R&D, Production, Finance and Compliance to build one clear view of what each supplier can do.
  • Negotiate the deal. You agree pricing, volume tiers, tooling and payment terms. You also set up the NDAs, supply agreements and long-term agreements that back them.
  • Set suppliers up properly. You onboard new suppliers and keep vendor data, price breaks and lead times current in our ERP system.
  • Lead supplier qualification. You coordinate our tiered qualification process, including quality agreements and first-article inspections.
  • Audit on site and remotely. You check suppliers for quality management, traceability and compliance. You also screen them against trade compliance requirements.
  • Keep builds moving. You place and expedite orders for prototype, validation, pilot and pre-series builds. You track supplier performance on delivery, price and quality.
  • Bring costs down. You work with suppliers on cost reduction, using should-cost and landed-cost models.
  • Grow our supplier base. You qualify suppliers for additional production sites and regions, reusing existing qualification records.
  • Make it repeatable. You document sourcing processes, templates and playbooks, so the purchasing team can take over mature suppliers.

    • Requirements
  • You have 6+ years in sourcing, purchasing or new product introduction for hardware products, across a variety of product types, complexities and technologies.
  • You can read technical drawings and specifications, and you work closely with engineers.
  • You’re willing to travel regularly, including international trips of several days.
  • You’ve audited suppliers hands-on or worked within a quality management system such as ISO 9001.
  • You have working knowledge of trade compliance rules.
  • You’ve used an ERP system for purchasing and vendor data.
  • You have a qualification in engineering, supply chain, business or a related field.
  • You communicate excellently in English and build good working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.

    • Plus
  • Experience in aerospace, drones or other safety-critical products
  • Experience sourcing custom electromechanical parts such as plastic parts, motors, batteries and avionics
  • Experience qualifying suppliers for production in more than one region
  • Experience with supplier scorecards and performance reporting
    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Senior Controls Engineer
data.description:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities


Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

data.title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
data.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow
  • Recruiter Interview
  • First Technical Interview
  • Coding / AI assisted coding interview
  • Mobile System Design Interview
  • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
  • Offer

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

data.description:
Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart

 

•            Impact maken, versnellen en professionaliseren

•            Mandaat en vrijheid

•            Locatie: Amersfoort

•            Uren: 32–40 uur

•            Opleidingsniveau: Hbo

•            Salaris: €4.800 – €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur

 

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales.

 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart

•   Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie.

•   Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering).

•   Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks.

•   Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal.

•   Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie).

•   Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention.

•   Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics.

•   Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou?

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT.

 

Wat biedt Snelstart

•   Brutosalaris €4.800 – €7.000 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.

•   30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur), maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.

•   Hybride werken, modern benefits-pakket, laptop en ergonomische werkplek (zit-sta).

•   Toegang tot sportschool met bedrijfskorting.

•   Cultuur die data, snelheid en creativiteit omarmt; ruimte en budget voor tooling/experimenten.

•   Directe invloed op product, strategie en roadmap; doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare omgeving.

•   Een betrokken team met 200+ collega’s.

Spreekt dit jou aan?  Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Wat is de procedure?

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de directeur commercie en product en HR. De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de directeur commercie en product en een externe adviseur. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaarden gesprek.

Slotopmerking

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!


Jouw profiel

Ervaring en competenties

•   Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

•   7+ jaar in growth/performance marketing of vergelijkbare data-gedreven SaaS-rol.

•   Sterk in strategie én executie; van visie naar vandaag nog live experimenten.

•   Analytisch: hypotheses, statistiek, funnel metrics, cohort analyses, CAC, LTV, incrementality.

•   Ervaring met A/B-testing, experiment design, CRO en gedragspsychologie.

•   Ervaren in samenwerking met Product, Design en Data; comfortabel in technisch productteam.

•   Bekend met GA4, HubSpot, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Looker/Power BI, Segment/Stitch, AI-tooling.

•   Creatief, schaal- en impactgericht, pragmatisch, eigenaarschap, hoog tempo.

•   Kwaliteitsgericht in de breedste zin.

Motivatie; je optimaliseert wordt blij van groei. En wordt blij van resultaat en je vindt de marketing puzzel leuk en enthousiasmeert je collega’s voor jouw vak en de impact die je maakt.

Persoonlijk: je gedreven en betrokken, oprecht en geeft je mening graag. Je deelt en geeft inzichten en werkt graag samen omdat het dan beter wordt. Je kan omgaan met feedback.  Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid en neemt de regie voor jouw werk

Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
data.description:
Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

•      Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices


A plus

•      Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure

•      Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Form an independent view on architecture and technology

•      Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working

•      Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters.


Salary & terms of employment

•      Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience

•      Year-end bonus, dependent on company results

•      25 holiday days per year

•      Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours

•      Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium

•      Laptop and phone provided


Working environment

•      Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data

•      Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines

•      Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme

•      An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative


Ready to build with us?

Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you.

Send your application and CV or LinkedIn profile to Questions about this vacancy? Get in touch with our Corporate Recruiter Veroniek Smits at the same address.

Please note that for this role we do not work with recruitment agencies, and we're unable to accept unsolicited candidate submissions or related fees.

data.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
data.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

  • Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp- en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria of productiefaciliteiten.

  • Uitwerken van elektrotechnische installaties op het gebied van o.a. energievoorziening, verlichting, brandveiligheid, zwakstroom-, beveiligings- en communicatievoorzieningen.

  • Opstellen van kabel- en lichtberekeningen met behulp van gespecialiseerde software.

  • Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines.

  • Ondersteunen van de ontwerpleider en projectmanager in de communicatie met klanten en partners.

 

Hier is waar 

  • We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. SRON verhuisde naar het Leiden BioScience Park en stelde hoge eisen aan het nieuwe gebouw op het gebied van duurzaamheid, cleanrooms en installatietechniek. Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Daarom koos Deerns in het ontwerp voor warmtepompen voor verwarming en koeling van het gebouw en werden er zonnepanelen op het dak geïnstalleerd. Bovendien kreeg het gebouw het BREEAM-NL certificaat Excellent.

Op basis van de inval van zonlicht in het gebouw, de energieprestatie-eisen en de strenge eisen voor de binnentemperatuur ontwierp Deerns een gevel die voor 25% gesloten is. Dit zorgt voor een natuurlijk koel binnenklimaat, waardoor energie wordt bespaard op verwarmings-, ventilatie- en airconditioningsystemen.

  • Jij hebt ervaring met werken in projecten en bent een uitstekende teamspeler.

  • Je hebt uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel geschreven als gesproken).

  • MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en andere berekeningsprogramma’s hebben geen geheimen voor jou.

 

Dit bieden wij 

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. 

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen.

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. data.title: Cost Manager (medior/senior)
data.description:
Ben jij ambitieus, analytisch sterk en klaar voor de volgende stap? Als Cost Manager bij ons advies- en ingenieursbureau werk je aan uitdagende projecten die zichtbaar impact maken. Je bewaakt kosten, adviseert over haalbaarheid en zorgt dat plannen financieel realistisch én toekomstbestendig zijn. Ons bureau is groot genoeg om op topniveau te opereren, maar overzichtelijk genoeg om je echt thuis te voelen. Je krijgt ruimte om te groeien, samen te werken met experts en bij te dragen aan duurzame, innovatieve oplossingen.

De uitdaging 

Binnen onze projecten groeit de behoefte aan betere budgetcontrole en sturing op kosten. Daarom breiden wij ons Cost Management-team uit. We zoeken een ervaren Cost Manager die het team wil versterken, verder helpen groeien tot een zelfstandige unit en zelf een leidende rol ambieert. Als Cost Manager ben je onderdeel van de unit Special Building Consultancy.

 

Als Cost Manager speel je een sleutelrol in het beheersen van kosten binnen complexe bouw- en investeringsprojecten. Jij zorgt dat projecten financieel realistisch en beheersbaar blijven van initiatief tot oplevering. Met jouw analytisch inzicht, projectervaring en overtuigingskracht adviseer je over kosten, waarde en haalbaarheid.

 

Je stuurt het integrale kostenmanagementproces aan en zorgt met betrouwbare en transparante kosteninformatie voor onderbouwde besluitvorming. Daarbij vertaal je financiële analyses en risico-inzichten naar concrete adviezen en bewaak je de toepassing van kostenbeheersingsmethodieken binnen projecten. Kortom een uitdagende functie voor een professional die inhoudelijke expertise combineert met leiderschap en wil bijdragen aan de verdere groei van ons Cost Management-team.

  • Opstellen van risicoanalyses en uitvoeren van probabilistische kostenanalyses;

  • Monitoren en rapporteren over voortgang, afwijkingen en prognoses t.o.v. budgetten en realisaties;

  • Onderbouwen van investeringsvoorstellen en businesscases met financiële analyses;

  • Beheersen van kostenrisico’s en -kansen gedurende het project;

  • Contractmanagement in de realisatiefase;

  • Bijdragen aan uniforme werkwijzen, benchmarks en kennisdeling binnen het team;

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
Heb jij diepgaande ervaring in werktuigbouwkundige installaties en wil je bijdragen aan de meest kritische en innovatieve datacenterprojecten van dit moment? Als Senior Mechanical Engineer Datacenters bij Deerns werkt je aan high-tech, schaalbare en energie-efficiënte faciliteiten die de digitale wereld draaiend houden. Jij ontwerpt de installaties die maximale betrouwbaarheid, duurzaamheid en continuïteit waarborgen precies waar de datacentersector om vraagt.

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Mechanical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties. Denk aan geavanceerde koelconcepten (zoals indirect/direct evaporative cooling, liquid cooling en chiller‑oplossingen), luchtbehandeling, warmte‑terugwinning, water‑ en gassystemen en klimaattechnische infrastructuur die 24/7 betrouwbaar moet functioneren.

Vanaf de eerste conceptfase denk je mee over technische strategieën en ontwerpkeuzes die aansluiten op schaalbaarheid, energie‑efficiëntie, beschikbaarheidsnormen (Tier III/) en de steeds strengere duurzaamheidsdoelen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines zoals elektrotechniek, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische integriteit en samenhang van het totaalontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.
 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Ontwerpen van mechanische gebouw gebonden systemen, waaronder HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), koeling en andere Datacenter specifieke installaties.

  • Meedenken in de concept‑ en ontwerpfase en vertalen van klantwensen naar haalbare en schaalbare technische oplossingen.

  • Coördineren van ontwerpactiviteiten met andere disciplines en bewaken van planning, kwaliteit en integrale samenhang.

  • Technisch aanspreekpunt zijn voor klanten, partners, leveranciers en interne stakeholders/junioren.

  • Begeleiden van engineers binnen het project en bijdragen aan kennisontwikkeling in het team.

  • Ondersteunen bij aanbestedingen, kostenramingen en kwaliteitscontroles (zowel ontwerp als uitvoering).

 

Waar werken we aan

We hebben meegewerkt aan de bouw van diverse nieuwe datacenters in o.a. Milaan, Amsterdam. We hebben ondersteuning geboden bij het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties voor de bouw. Na het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties heeft Deerns toezicht gehouden op de bouwplaats om de kwaliteit van de installaties te controleren en heeft het als Commissioning manager voor de hoofdaannemer gefungeerd. Deerns heeft ook ondersteuning geboden bij de bouw om een Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED)-certificering te behalen. LEED-certificering betekent dat een gebouw gezond en zeer efficiënt is en betere milieuprestaties levert.

Het team 

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een team met circa 16 collega’s, binnen de bredere organisatie waarin je meer dan 750 collega's in verschillende sectoren zal hebben. Het Data Center team is een hecht team dat bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers. De cultuur is open, kennis gedreven en gericht op samenwerking en plezier in het werk. Bovendien werk je in een hecht, integraal projectteam waarin ieders kennis en expertise optimaal wordt benut. Dit zorgt niet alleen voor sterke samenwerking, maar ook voor persoonlijke groei. De unit Datacenters werkt voornamelijk in opdracht van Colocattie providers, banken en grote bedrijven, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Dit zorgt ervoor dat je aan gevarieerde projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is. Daarnaast werk je regelmatig samen met onze units in Engeland, Spanje en Brazilie  waardoor je onderdeel bent van een sterk internationaal netwerk.


Dit ben jij 

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo- of wo‑opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Installatietechniek of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring (bij voorkeur 5+) als Mechanical Engineer binnen complexe gebouwgebonden installaties ervaring met datacenters of mission critical omgevingen is een sterke pre.

  • Je hebt ervaring met multidisciplinaire projectomgevingen en kunt uitstekend samenwerken met collega's uit andere vakgebieden.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je bent vaardig met MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en relevante reken- en simulatiesoftware (zoals Vabi, CFD‑tools, koellastberekeningen e.d.).

  • Je bent analytisch sterk, technisch nieuwsgierig en schakelt moeiteloos tussen detailniveau en totaaloverzicht.

data.title: Senior Electrical Engineer

Als Senior Electrical Engineer Datacenters bij Deerns werk je aan high‑tech, schaalbare en energie‑efficiënte faciliteiten die de digitale wereld draaiend houden. Jij ontwerpt de elektrotechnische systemen die maximale betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en continuïteit waarborgen precies waar de datacentersector om vraagt. 

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter-afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe elektrotechnische installaties. Denk aan middenspannings- en laagspanningsverdelers, UPS‑systemen, generatoren, noodstroomconcepten, earthing & bonding, automatisering, beveiligingssystemen, energieopwekking en power monitoring die 24/7 betrouwbaar moeten functioneren. 

Vanaf de eerste conceptfase denk je mee over technische strategieën en ontwerpkeuzes die aansluiten op schaalbaarheid, energie‑efficiëntie, beschikbaarheidsnormen (Tier III/IV) en steeds strengere duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen. Je werkt intensief samen met disciplines zoals werktuigbouwkunde, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische samenhang van het integrale ontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.

We hebben meegewerkt aan de bouw van diverse nieuwe datacenters in o.a. Milaan, Amsterdam. Deerns heeft ook ondersteuning geboden bij de bouw om een Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED)-certificering te behalen. Dit zorgt ervoor dat je aan gevarieerde projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is. Als Teamleider Brandveiligheid bij Deerns sta jij aan het roer van een groeiend team van specialisten en geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
Ben jij een Senior Mechanical Engineer die impact wil maken in één van de meest kritische technische omgevingen? Binnen onze unit Airports werk je aan hoogwaardige projecten die direct bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en duurzame luchthaveninfrastructuur. De uitdaging 

In deze rol ben jij de inhoudelijke werktuigbouwkundige spil binnen complexe luchthavenprojecten, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Werken in een 24uurs luchthavenomgeving maakt deze rol bijzonder dynamisch en uitdagend. De complexiteit van zowel de klant als de situatie vraagt om flexibiliteit, snel schakelen en creatief denken. Juist deze afwisseling zorgt ervoor dat geen dag hetzelfde is.


Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Je ontwerpt en adviseert zelfstandig over complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen luchthavenprojecten en vertaalt ontwerpen van schets tot technische uitwerking in AutoCAD en BIM. Je zet BIM‑structuren op en begeleidt en corrigeert junior collega’s.

  • Het inhoudelijk bijdragen aan conceptontwikkeling en het vertalen van ontwerpuitgangspunten naar haalbare en integrale oplossingen.
